title: Kim and the Day Nothing Happened
synopsis: Kim checks the garden on several successive days without seeing sprouts, but notices rain, an insect, differences in soil moisture and a place to stand.
continuity_state: Before: Radish and sunflower seeds are planted; small garden sign and row pictures in place; no seedlings visible. Kim has not visited the planted garden. After: Monday through Friday visits pass without visible sprouts. Rain leaves unequal moisture under the porch edge; Grandma checks dryness and waters lightly as needed. Grandma places two flat stepping stones on dry path outside the seeded bed, after Kim notices a footprint near it. Kim retains all three pouch pebbles. No seeds are dug up.

related_resources.reason: Rain exposure varies beneath an overhang; checking soil moisture is consistent with extension guidance to keep radish soil appropriately watered.
The passing afternoon provides an observation opportunity; UCAR explains why shadow length varies with light angle. The scene does not assess inquiry skills.
